data.title: Determination of degree of disability (GdB 40)
data.summary: The Versorgungsamt Beispielfeld decided on your application of 19 February 2026 and determined a degree of disability (Grad der Behinderung, GdB) of 40, based on a spinal condition with disc damage (single GdB 30) and high blood pressure (single GdB 20); no Merkzeichen was granted.
data.explanation: This letter sets your official degree of disability (GdB) at 40. With this level you are not entitled to a disability ID card (issued only from GdB 50), but you could ask the Agentur für Arbeit to grant you "Gleichstellung" (equal status to a severely disabled person), which can give you some protections at work. If you disagree with the GdB or the finding that no Merkzeichen applies, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Versorgungsamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing by then, the decision becomes final. This GdB may also be usable in your tax return to claim the disability lump-sum allowance.
